text: [[img:icon_warpstones]][[/img]]Warpstone is a shimmering, emerald-green crystalline substance, the physical manifestation of pure magic in the real world\\n\\nSkaven can gather [[img:icon_warpstones]][[/img]]Warpstone by constructing Warpstone Mines. Consuming [[img:icon_warpstones]][[/img]]Warpstone can power certain buildings, research unique faction technologies, or empower your units
